sents.t: We regret to inform you that your flight AX205 from Chicago to Boston on April 9 has been rescheduled.
It will now depart at 4:15 P.M. instead of 1:30 P.M.
If the new time does not work for you, you may change to another flight at no extra cost.
As an apology, we have added a free meal voucher to your booking.
It can be used at any restaurant in the airport, which should help you survive the extra waiting time.
